script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: forgiveness

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. LOCKER ROOM - DAY

JASON (mid 30s, ripped physique, intense gaze) stands before the mirror, adjusting his team jersey. Coach WALLACE (late 50s, distinguished, firm) enters.

WALLACE
(serious)
Jason, we need to talk.

JASON
(turns, tense)
Coach, we won.

WALLACE
(nods)
Yes, we did. But there's something more important than winning.

INT. COACHES OFFICE - DAY

Jason sits across from Wallace.

WALLACE
(leaning forward)
There's been a lot of tension in the team recently. Some of the players have been bullying your brother, Ethan.

JASON
(angered)
What? Why didn't you tell me sooner?

WALLACE
(calm)
We tried to handle it discreetly. But it's come to a head, and I need your help to resolve it.

INT. GYM - DAY

Jason confronts MIKE (early 30s, muscular, sneering), the ringleader of the bullies.

JASON
(angry)
What's your problem with Ethan?

MIKE
(smirking)
He's just a loser. A waste of space.

JASON
(grabbing Mike by the collar)
That's my brother you're talking about. You'll respect him or there'll be consequences.

INT. LOCKER ROOM - DAY

Jason and Ethan (early 30s, shy, dejected) sit on opposite benches.

ETHAN
(whispering)
Thanks for standing up for me.

JASON
(sighs)
We're a team. We should have each other's backs.

ETHAN
(smiling weakly)
Yeah, I guess so.

INT. SCHOOL HALLWAY - DAY

Jason approaches MIKE.

JASON
(calm, serious)
We need to talk.

MIKE
(mocking)
Ooh, are we having a heart-to-heart now?

JASON
(stern)
No. This is a warning. Stop bullying Ethan.

MIKE
(laughs)
Or what? You'll what? Punch me?

JASON
(shaking his head)
No. I'll tell Coach Wallace what you've been doing.

MIKE's expression changes. He knows Jason means business.

INT. COACHES OFFICE - DAY

Wallace gathers the team.

WALLACE
(serious)
There's been some disturbing behavior in our locker room. Bullying. I need to know, is this something you condone?

ONE BY ONE, the team members look down or shake their heads.

WALLACE
(looking at Jason)
Jason?

JASON
(proud)
No, coach.

INT. LOCKER ROOM - LATER

Jason and Ethan share a warm embrace.

ETHAN
(grateful)
Thanks for sticking up for me.

JASON
(smiling)
We're a team. We should have each other's backs.

INT. FIELD - NIGHT

The team, including Jason and Ethan, gathers around their coach. They've won the championship.

WALLACE
(proud)
You all did this. You showed strength, courage, and forgiveness.

JASON
(looking at Ethan)
We did it together.

ETHAN
(smiling)
Yeah, we did.

FADE OUT.

END OF SCREENPLAY.
